description: Cancels a booking, or declines a request (two steps: the first call returns confirm_token and what happens; the second, after the user agrees, emails the customer). series "rest": every later date too. A waitlist entry_id (wl_…) takes that person off (two steps when a held place passes on). A class_id (cl_…): cancels the whole class, one email each.

confirm_token.description: From the first call, after the user's yes

notify_customer.description: Email the customer (default true when there is an email)

series.description: "this" (default) or "rest" (this date and every later one)

name: cancel_booking
title: Cancel a booking
